contract: Whether the product's own name and logo are suppressed for a given booking is a single derived property of that booking's event type, and it must be resolved everywhere through the shared event-scoped resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts — which folds the parent organization's hideBranding over the team's or the owner-profile's own value — so that a message an automation sends to an attendee carries exactly the branding the same customer sees on the page they book from. Reading a raw hideBranding column off one entity (the event type's owner, or the workflow's own userId/teamId), or loading a row whose select omits the team and the parent organization, breaks that contract because it silently drops the organization-level entitlement and, for team events with a null owner, drops the setting entirely.

defect_location.summary: The contract is defined at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 (resolveHideBranding returns true whenever options.organizationHideBranding is set) and exposed event-scoped at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:85-110,158-164,169-181, backed by packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-473 (selects team.hideBranding AND parent.hideBranding) and packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1336 (selects user.hideBranding AND profiles[].organization.hideBranding). The booking pages honour it: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,103, apps/web/lib/org/[orgSlug]/instant-meeting/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:85, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:253 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58 all call shouldHideBrandingFor*Event. The automation path does not, in two distinct ways. First, the cron that actually sends due reminder emails recomputes the flag from raw columns: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, 274-276 and 433-435 each read `reminder.booking.eventType?.team ? !!reminder.booking.eventType?.team?.hideBranding : !!reminder.booking.user?.hideBranding`, never consulting team.parent.hideBranding or the user's org profile, and the row it reads is shaped to make that impossible — packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:40 and :169-201 select only `team: { parentId, hideBranding }` and `user: { hideBranding }`, fetching parentId but never the parent's own flag. Second, the callers that schedule reminders pass a value read off the wrong entity: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618,2793,2808, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459,472 (whose select at :308-313 and :358-363 loads only owner.hideBranding), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188 and packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230 all pass `!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding`, which is null for every team event; the underlying select at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:109-113 (and the public-page analogue at packages/prisma/selects/event-types.ts:118-124) fetches owner.hideBranding and nothing else. Third, the workflow services resolve by the wrong id: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 calls getHideBranding({userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId}) — the workflow's owner, not the booking's event type — and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same from form.userId/form.teamId. The value then travels untouched through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,97,161,213,248,262,267,280, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,115,147,182,204, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,38,82, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/scheduleBookingReminders.ts and packages/features/tasker/tasks/triggerFormSubmittedNoEvent/triggerFormSubmittedNoEventWorkflow.ts:29,41,66 into the rendered body (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:491) and out through packages/emails/templates/workflow-email.ts, which decides nothing itself — confirming the decision point is upstream.
